beats.event: Grows up in Torrance, California, a troublemaking boy
Brother Pete coaches him; becomes the 'Torrance Tornado'
Runs the 5,000m at 1936 Berlin Olympics, placing eighth
Enlists as a bombardier in the Pacific Theater
Survives a heavily damaged bomber's crash landing
Green Hornet crashes; eight of eleven crew are killed
Adrift on a life raft with Phil and Mac
Day 18: prays and promises God his life if rescued
Survives 46 days at sea; captured by the Japanese
Ofuna: guard 'The Bird' tortures him relentlessly
Refuses to record enemy propaganda broadcasts
War ends; freed and comes home traumatized
Marries Cynthia; battles alcoholism and nightmares
A Billy Graham crusade sparks his spiritual reawakening
Forgives his tormentors; carries Olympic torch in 1998 Nagano
